subject: planner: avoid repeat normalization on the same query when matching binding for plan cache (#50133)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent (6eea739d) in planner/executor/session paths that consult SQL bindings for plan cache. The change removes `core.GetBindSQL4PlanCache` and replaces all call sites with `bindinfo.MatchSQLBindingForPlanCache`, adding per-statement cached normalization state via `PlanCacheStmt.BindingInfo` (`bindinfo.BindingMatchInfo`). Verified binding selection/precedence and skip-plan-cache behavior remain consistent: still gated by `UsePlanBaselines` and `SessionBindInfoKeyType`, still prefers session over global bindings, and still respects `IGNORE_PLAN_CACHE` via `ContainTableHint(hint.HintIgnorePlanCache)` (`pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go`, `pkg/executor/prepared.go`, `pkg/session/session.go`, `pkg/server/driver_tidb.go`, `pkg/bindinfo/binding_match.go`). No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/txn-session behavior from these changes.
